positions.title: Software Architect & Lead Developer
positions.description: Java/EE architect for the ICEcore Team which is the company's next-generation web-based team collaboration product written in Java. Responsible for the overall architecture of the system. Lead developer for the infrastructure and back-end.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior developer in a new team formed to design and develop Ascential's next generation enterprise data integration software product using Java and Java EE technology. Primary contributor to the design of the Data Access Application Programming Interface (DAAPI) and the Service Provider Interface (DASPI).

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented several components of AltaVista Enterprise Search product including the management/control infrastructure and framework, socket-based multi-threaded server container, Java-based administration API, data crawler framework, database crawler, and disk-based document pipeline. Played key role in revamping the overall product architecture from C-based to Java-based resulting in significant improvement in product quality, portability, and productivity.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on several projects designing and developing distributed or client-server based systems at both application and system level primarily using C on UNIX and NT. An example is 180,000 lines of highly complex C code written for a distributed information database and repository server featuring transactional integrity, inverted B-tree index, wildcard/proximity support, caching, instant update with multi-tiered indexes, metadata versioning, and high concurrency with multi-threaded support.

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description: Under the direction of a senior researcher, developed network optimization simulation software with particular emphasis on the performance and user-friendly interface. Actively assisted in the conversion of the complex mathematical algorithms into a feasible software. Received a Software Development Award by GTE Lab Award Committee.

honors.title: CEO Award - For being an EXPERT
honors.description:
Award Statement From Company

Jong has been instrumental in developing a new Unified Architecture for Data Protector that will support backup/restore for new Non-SQL databases along with third party developed applications.  Jong anticipates obstacles, addresses challenges early on, and regularly demonstrates best practices that not only deliver functionality on an aggressive schedule, but lifts the engineering teams up to enable them to thrive.

honors.title: Overall Winner for the FY14 Celebrate! Annual Values and Beliefs Awards (Employee of the Year)
honors.description:
Award Statement From Company

To say that Jong goes the extra mile would be a gross understatement of his commitment to the company and our products. Jong has the highest respect among the entire Novell Filr engineering team by putting forth an amazing amount of extra effort. He is consistently active in resolving outstanding defects, following through with beta customer issues in the online forums, creating and reviewing design documents and decisions, participating in project meetings, and following through on assignments. Even though Jong has a lot of important work on his plate, he is always very willing to help others solve problems and provide technical insight and suggestions. Jong has solved very difficult problems. His idea for and implementation of JITS in Filr made the product usable in a large-scale environment. Jong is always thorough in his work. He analyzes problems, shares and describes alternatives, evaluates proposals, and sends detailed results on development tasks and status reports. His written and verbal communication skills are among the best in the group. Jong has a way of not only solving a problem, but of describing why his approach is well thought and almost assuredly the best one. Jong is dedicated, professional, and takes ownership and pride in his work.
